headline: Every bag of feed checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Stockfeed, grain mixes and pet food
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With so many mixes going into similar bags, the label is what tells one feed from the next. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your bagging line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every bag is stitched or sealed shut, straight across. An open bag spills in the truck and becomes a return from the store.
labelLede: Layer pellets and chick starter look much the same in a bag at line speed, and the wrong feed for the wrong animal is a real problem for the customer. The camera checks every bag carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The batch code ties every bag back to its mix, which FeedSafe audits rely on. The system reads the printed code on every bag and compares it with the mix and date set at changeover.
objectLede: String offcuts, bag scraps and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before bags are palletised.

vocab.alert: Four crooked closures in fifteen minutes. Check the bag closer.
